text: およぎ　ながら　ポケモンを　だすのって　けっこう　むずかしいん　だから！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　だすのって
けっこう　むずかしいん　だから！

patterns.name: 〜ながら
patterns.explanation: ながら after a verb means doing that at the same time as something else. およぎ　ながら = 'while swimming'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.span: ポケモンを　だすの
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing' in English. The って that follows is a casual は. ポケモンを　だすの = 'sending out Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜のだから
patterns.span: むずかしいん　だから
patterns.explanation: のだから, said as んだから, ends a sentence with 'because it's so, you know', as a protest or excuse. むずかしいん　だから = 'it's hard, you know!'.
